Shopify Store Redesign & Optimization

A Shopify store redesign should do more than update how your store looks — it should fix the specific friction points, layout flaws and performance issues that are costing you sales right now. Agentix approaches every Shopify redesign with conversion data first and aesthetics second: we audit what's broken, design what converts, and build what lasts. Our Shopify website redesign, Shopify conversion optimization and Shopify store optimization work starts with data before we touch design.

Why it matters

A store engineered to convert — not just to look good.

If you're an ambitious ecommerce brand, shopify store redesign & optimization should compound revenue at every visit. Here's what we help you achieve:

  • Lift conversion rate across mobile and desktop.
  • Cut friction from browse to checkout.
  • Build on a fast, scalable foundation that grows with you.

We combine conversion-first design, clean development and performance into stores that are a pleasure to use and built to scale.

What's included

Everything you get with Shopify Store Redesign & Optimization.

01

Pre-redesign CRO audit

Heatmaps, analytics and session recordings reviewed before design begins — identifying the specific friction points, drop-off moments and layout failures the redesign must fix.

02

Conversion-led redesign

New design system — homepage, collection pages, product pages, cart — built around the findings from the CRO audit and your brand's updated direction.

03

Brand refresh integration

If your brand identity is evolving alongside the redesign, we ensure new typography, color and visual language is applied consistently and purposefully across every template.

04

SEO preservation

Full audit of your current rankings and URL structure before redesign begins — 301 redirects, canonical handling and structured data preserved or improved throughout the build.

05

Performance lift

New theme code targeting Core Web Vitals 90+ — because a beautiful slow store is still a failing store.

06

A/B testing setup

Post-launch A/B testing infrastructure so improvements continue to compound after the redesign goes live.

How it works

A clear path from audit to growth.

Step 01

Audit

Analytics review, heatmap analysis and ranking baseline — understanding what the redesign must fix before touching design tools.

Step 02

Step 03

Clean Shopify development with SEO preservation, performance and conversion built in.

Step 04

Controlled launch, post-launch monitoring and CRO iteration to compound results.

Questions

Good to know.

Key signals: conversion rate below industry average (typically 1.5–3%), mobile experience notably worse than desktop, bounce rate above 70% on key pages, outdated brand presentation, or Core Web Vitals scores below 50. We offer a free store audit to assess this.

Not if managed correctly. We audit your current rankings, preserve all existing URL structures and implement 301 redirects for any URLs that must change — protecting your rankings through the transition.

A redesign overhauls the visual system, information architecture and layouts — typically when the store's structure itself is the problem. CRO optimization makes targeted improvements to an existing design based on data. Both are valuable; the audit tells us which is right.
